_README.why: The reference the bullet walk is measured against, and it does NOT come from the walk. Every list below was written by reading the neighbouring .md file the way a person reads it, then the parser was run against it -- never the other way round. A reviewer who suspects otherwise can delete `scripts/finished_work_audit.py` and still say what each of these documents means.
_README.the-defect-this-replaces: test_criteria_parser.py compared `criteria_split` to `criteria_split` with the five inline patterns switched off. Both halves share the bullet walk, so no mutation inside the walk could ever make it red. Replayed 2026-08-21: six mutations of that walk left the 32 tests green, four of them changing the real output of the instrument the whole repository is measured with.
_README.how-to-add-a-document: Write the .md, write its two lists here by hand, and only then run the suite. If the two disagree, one of them is wrong and the disagreement is the finding -- do not paste the parser's answer in.
_README.regeneration: There is none, on purpose. A regeneration command would turn this file back into a copy of the code it measures.
how-a-mutation-is-replayed: copy scripts/finished_work_audit.py outside the repository -- that copy is what restores it

apply ONE change to the parser (drop `target.pop()`, write `#{2}` for `#{2,3}`, drop the `buffer.append(line.strip())` that continues a bullet, make `_BLOCKQUOTE` never match, make `_REPLACES_HEADING` never match, drop the `close_bullet()` a blank line performs)
python scripts/finished_work_audit.py --inline-criteria   # what the instrument now answers
restore the file from the copy, byte for byte, and check it
_README.measured-2026-08-21: Before this corpus existed, those six left all 32 tests green. After it, all six are red on `test_the_walk_returns_what_a_reader_reads`, and so are the five mutations that were already dying: 11 replayed, 0 survivors.

bullets.md.reads: the four shapes a bullet is written in: dashed, numbered, carried over two lines, and separated from its list by a blank line
listed: a dashed bullet, stated on one line
a dashed bullet whose sentence continues on the following line
a numbered bullet, because two ratified pages number theirs
a numbered bullet that ends on a semicolon
a bullet separated from the list above by a blank line

h3-amendments.md.reads: an amendment that opens its own H3, and the French heading `user-bridge.md` uses
listed: the opening criterion of the page
a criterion added by the amendment, under a heading of its own
une puce ratifiee sous un titre francais, qui n'est pas moins contraignante

replaces.md.reads: a SUBSTITUTION: the replaced bullet leaves the list, and the replacement takes its index -- so the list still holds two criteria, not three
listed: the first criterion of the page
the replacement, which takes the index the replaced bullet held

inline-clauses.md.reads: every form that is NOT a bullet of the established list, and the one form that is. The order of `appended` is document order, which is the whole reason no verdict may be keyed on it.
listed: the only bullet of the established list
a bullet under the end-of-line opener, which belongs to the established list
appended: a clause stated at column zero, ahead of the page's own list
a clause carried on the opener's own line, which does not
a bullet under an inline opener, which is appended and never listed
a clause indented under a numbered step, after a blank line
a version is bound without evidence

not-read-and-why.a continuation of the sentence above, an: indented, and the line above it is not blank -- an indented marker there continues the sentence it hangs under
not-read-and-why.clause 2 of this page is prose about the: the sentence makes `Incomplete if` its object
not-read-and-why.ratified |: the table cell ends at the pipe; the next column is another subject

blockquote.md.reads: the fence is stripped for the inline forms and NEVER for the bullet ones -- a quoted bullet would otherwise enter the established list and move every index under it
listed: the established bullet of this page
appended: a clause ratified inside a blockquote of this page

prose-about-the-list.md.reads: the three refusals: a sentence that makes the marker its object, a tail too short to be a sentence, and a tail that opens on punctuation
listed: the single real criterion of this page
